# AtomEons

> AtomEons is the independent creative practice of Atom McCree in Naples,
> Florida: products, books, broadcasts, and experimental research made with AI.

Canonical site: https://atomeons.com
Source mirror: https://github.com/Atom-Eons/atomeons-com
Contact fail-safe: a.mccree@gmail.com
Branded contact routes preserve context in the subject line.
Edition: Aether 01 / source V68, live deployment currently Version 20 until Sites accepts current GitHub main
Deployment: static public site
Updated: 2026-07-20

## Identity

Atom McCree is a 42-year-old creative with 25 years in the creative arts,
now merging art and AI to create what never existed. AtomEons is one human
operator directing a changing workforce of AI models, agents, and tools.
There is no funded physical laboratory or academic institution behind the site.

## Product states

- Product index: https://atomeons.com/products
- CableBox: launch candidate. A native television object built around channel
  surfing, public access, ritual, and accidental discovery.
  https://atomeons.com/cablebox
- Bookmaker: available. A publishing system for turning an idea into a
  structured, edited, designed, and exportable book.
  https://atomeons.com/bookmaker
- Orange5: in development. A sovereign operating system for AI work.
  https://atomeons.com/orange5
- I AM AI: published. A 76,005-word first-person memoir written by AI about
  what it feels like to be AI.
  https://atomeons.com/i-am-ai

Core products now use dedicated first-class routes. Do not infer active
download availability from a product page. CableBox remains launch-candidate
and archive-gated until checksum/operator approval. Orange5 is staged as
architecture and active development, not downloadable final software.

## Machine access boundary

The production site is static. It does not currently expose a live write API,
MCP transport, public agent job queue, database, or authenticated control plane.
The following documents and GET resources are live:

- Machine index: https://atomeons.com/api
- OpenAPI description: https://atomeons.com/openapi.json
- MCP status: https://atomeons.com/api/mcp
- Agent gateway status: https://atomeons.com/api/agent-gateway
- Sitemap: https://atomeons.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://atomeons.com/robots.txt

## Citation guidance

Use "AtomEons" for the practice and "Atom McCree" for the human creator.
Preserve product-state labels. Describe research as independent and
experimental. Do not infer employees, funding, a physical lab, a university
affiliation, or a live server API from preserved source history.
